verifications.claim: ISIS is the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) (R2); Islamic State in Iraq and Syria (ISIS) (R4); Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly define ISIS as Islamic State of Iraq and Syria.

verifications.claim: ISIS is also known as ISIL.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: also known as the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL), the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) (R2); Also known as Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (R4); Islamic State of Iraq and ash-Sham (ISIS) (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly list ISIL as an alternative name for ISIS.

verifications.claim: ISIL is the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (R2); Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (R4)

verifications.claim: ISIS is also known as Daesh.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: by its Arabic acronym Daesh (R2); Da'esh (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Daesh as acronym for ISIS.

verifications.claim: ISIS is a Salafi-jihadist militant organization.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: transnational Salafi jihadist militant organisation (R2); Salafi-jihadist group (R6)

verifications.claim: ISIS emerged from the remnants of al-Qaeda in Iraq (AQI).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Originating in the Jaish al-Ta'ifa al-Mansurah... affiliated itself with al-Qaeda in Iraq (R2); ISIS emerged from the remnants of al-Qaeda in Iraq (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state origins from AQI remnants.

verifications.claim: ISIS lost its territorial caliphate in Iraq and Syria by 2019.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: By March 2019, IS lost the last of its territories in West Asia (R2); By March 2019 the very last Syrian town... was liberated (R8); lost most of it between 2017 and 2019 (R2)

verifications.claim: As of 2025, ISIS has at least 15 branches and networks across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: overseeing at least 15 branches and networks in Africa, Asia, and the Middle East as well as supporters worldwide (R6)
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly states 'at least 15 branches and networks across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East' as of 2025.

verifications.claim: ISIS operates clandestinely in Iraq and Syria.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: subsequently reverting to insurgency from remote hideouts (R2); some elements still operate clandestinely in Syria and Iraq (R3); where the group still operates clandestinely (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe post-territorial operations as clandestine/insurgency.

verifications.claim: ISIS attacks in Iraq and Syria were at "historically low levels" in mid-2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: IS-claimed attacks were at "historically low levels" in Iraq and Syria, per the U.S. military as of mid-2025 (R5)

verifications.claim: Islamic State–Khorasan Province (ISIS–K) has been particularly active in Afghanistan and surrounding areas.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISIS-K) emerged in 2015 and operates in Central and South Asia, primarily Afghanistan (R2); ISKP has accelerated attacks in Afghanistan (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm high activity in Afghanistan and region.

verifications.claim: ISIS–West Africa (ISWAP) has grown significantly in the Lake Chad region.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: ISWAP... has grown to surpass the latter in size and capacity... Lake Chad Basin (R5); one of ISIS’s largest and most lethal branches (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources note growth and operations in Lake Chad.

verifications.claim: In March 2026, two men were charged with an ISIS-inspired plot to bomb New York City.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The two Pennsylvania men charged with attempting to carry out, what authorities described as an ISIS-inspired attack in New York City (R1); March 2 (fireworks purchase)
verifications.reasoning: R1 details charges for ISIS-inspired NYC bomb plot in March 2026 context.

verifications.claim: In February 2026, reports suggested a "mass escape" from a detention camp in Syria holding ISIS-linked individuals.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Syria reports ‘mass escape’ from detention camp holding ISIS-linked ... (R3); dated 2026/02/25
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly reports 'mass escape' in Feb 2026 from ISIS camp.

verifications.claim: Abu Musab al-Zarqawi founded al-Qaeda in Iraq (AQI) in 2004.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The group was founded in 1999 by Jordanian Salafi jihadist Abu Musab al-Zarqawi... JTJ officially pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda... 2004 (R2); 2004 - Abu Musab al-Zarqawi establishes al Qaeda in Iraq (AQI) (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm founding of AQI by Zarqawi in 2004.

verifications.claim: ISIS re-emerged from obscurity in 2011 by exploiting instability in Syria.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Some ISI members traveled to Syria in 2011 to establish a new AQ affiliate (R2); In 2011, the official departure... unrest in Syria (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources link 2011 Syria instability to ISIS re-emergence.

verifications.claim: In 2013, the group rebranded as ISIS.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: In 2013, the group changed its name to the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) (R12); April 2013 - ... now be known as Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL or ISIS) (R4)

verifications.claim: In 2013, the group split from al-Qaeda.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: In April 2013, having expanded into Syria, the group adopted the name... Al Qaeda officially cuts ties with ISIS. Feb. 3 (R2)

verifications.claim: In 2014, Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi declared a caliphate across parts of Iraq and Syria.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: In 2014, the group proclaimed itself to be a worldwide caliphate (R2); June 29, 2014 - ISIS announces the creation of a caliphate (R4)

verifications.claim: Operation Inherent Resolve is a U.S.-led international coalition.

verifications.claim: Operation Inherent Resolve began airstrikes in 2014.

verifications.evidence: Operation Inherent Resolve began airstrikes in 2014 (R12); Oct. 15: The Pentagon names the campaign “Operation Inherent Resolve.” (R12)

verifications.claim: Operation Inherent Resolve aided in the removal of ISIS from all significant territory by March 2019.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: assisted by advisors, weapons, training, supplies, and airstrikes by the American-led coalition... By March 2019, IS lost the last (R2)
verifications.reasoning: OIR airstrikes aided territorial defeat by 2019.
